notes: You can now get files and images into the chat three ways: paste a copied file from Explorer (Ctrl+V), paste a screenshot/image (Ctrl+V), or drag a file onto the window. Before, only the paperclip button worked and pasted images were silently dropped.

Drag-and-drop now works anywhere in the window (not just exactly on the chat box), and a stray drop no longer breaks the app by navigating away. Note: if you run Wingman as Administrator, Windows blocks drag-and-drop from Explorer — use paste or the paperclip there.
